newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms buy 50,000T Brazilian soybean.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms buy 50,000T Brazilian soybean.

text.p: Two South Korean soybean crushers bought a total of 50,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybean from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp in a private negotiation, officials at the two companies said on Monday.
The two companies are Cheiljedang Corp and Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd, they said. Of the total, Cheiljedang bought 35,000 tonnes and Sam Yang took the remaining 15,000 tonnes.
They said the purchase was made at a basis price over September futures on the Chicago Board of Trade.
Shipment was set for July to South Korea's western port of Inchon.
